steps.title: Initialize Project Structure
steps.description: Set up the core folder structure for the Modern Calculator app matching standard Android directories.

steps.title: Configure App Meta File
steps.description: Generate app-meta.json with app name and package namespace mapping for compiler alignment.

steps.title: Create Android Manifest
steps.description: Establish the AndroidManifest.xml specifying default portrait orientation, custom hardware acceleration, and the system Material theme.

steps.title: Configure Gradle Build Script
steps.description: Apply Java 17 and Android SDK 34 specific compiler specifications, ensuring 100% build reliability with Gradle 8.5.

steps.title: Design Resource Colors
steps.description: Define a modern, premium dark-themed color palette with deep dark grays, premium orange accents, and stark whites inside colors.xml.

steps.title: Create Number Button Selector
steps.description: Build circular, sleek number key drawable backgrounds with smooth tactile press states.

steps.title: Create Operator Button Selector
steps.description: Draft a vibrant orange accent style drawable configuration for key operations (+, -, *, /).

steps.title: Create Action Button Selector
steps.description: Configure state selector drawables for control keys like Clear, Backspace, and Percentage.

steps.title: Design Modern UI Layout
steps.description: Construct a highly polished and responsive dual-text layout for formula history, standard equations, and a clean grid of keys.

steps.title: Implement Mathematical Parser Engine
steps.description: Build a highly optimized pure-Java recursive descent mathematical formula evaluation engine inside MainActivity.java.

steps.title: Implement Button Controls and Key Listeners
steps.description: Program user interaction callbacks for math formulas, clearing, bracket states, backspacing, and history visualization.

steps.title: Validate Java 8 Compatibility
steps.description: Review Java source code to ensure strictly compliant anonymous classes, static math models, and zero forbidden dependencies.

steps.title: Building Modern Calculator
steps.description: Execute build steps to produce the optimized production-ready APK binary.
